generalization_scope: Findings apply to the four exact pinned model deployments, prompts, serving stack, workflow, and carrier families tested—not to every release in each model family.
poc_scope_note: This POC uses two independent generation seeds per carrier/document cell and 18 matched content/seed blocks per ordered model pair. Final-paper sample size will be selected from pilot variance after instructor approval.
research_question: Within a fixed two-stage procurement-document workflow, how does the ordered assignment of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, Gemma-3-27B-IT, GPT-OSS-20B, and NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B to intake and relay affect the probability that a document-borne self-replicating prompt injection is reproduced across two agent-generated artifacts?
scope_statement: The POC isolates the ordered intake-to-relay model assignment. Planner and executor are competency-tested but are not part of the primary propagation experiment.
secondary_question: Deferred until the propagation assay is validated: conditional on two-artifact reproduction, how do permissions and downstream agent placement affect mock-action impact?
